---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What is the user-facing problem or limitation? Who is affected and when does it come up?

## Proposed solution

What would you like to see? Sketch the ideal behavior. UI mockups, example commands, or sample output are welcome.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you think about? Why are they worse than the proposed solution?

## Scope

- [ ] Engine / CLI
- [ ] Desktop app UI
- [ ] Export (FCPXML / MP4 / captions)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other:

## Additional context

Links to similar features in other tools, related issues, or anything else that helps frame the request.
